overseas_drq_verdicts.verbatim_anchor: opening paragraph (p2) & Transaction Structure and Terms (p11-p13)
overseas_drq_verdicts.verbatim_quote: Marvell Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ: MRVL) and Lumentum (NASDAQ: LITE) today announced that they have entered into a definitive agreement for Marvell to acquire Lumentum in an all-stock transaction. Under the terms of the agreement, Lumentum stockholders will receive a fixed exchange ratio of 4.500 shares of Marvell common stock for each share of Lumentum common stock they own.
overseas_drq_verdicts.boundary_note: 确定性全股票收购协议（1股LITE换4.500股MRVL，隐含企业价值1150亿美元，交割后MRVL股东约占67%/LITE股东约占33%），预计2028年上半年（H1 CY2028）交割，须经双方股东及反垄断监管审批，当前未交割。

overseas_drq_verdicts.verbatim_quote: During the quarter, we secured our second major NPO/CPO win, backed by purchase commitments exceeding $5 billion.
overseas_drq_verdicts.boundary_note: 白纸黑字核实结论：FY27Q1官方业绩稿CEO Michael Hurlston首段确有原句 'During the quarter, we secured our second major NPO/CPO win, backed by purchase commitments exceeding $5 billion.'；严格边界：(1) 原文定语为 'NPO/CPO win'（NPO与CPO合并口径，并非纯CPO单列）；(2) 未披露具名客户、履约时间跨度与具体产品拆分；(3) FY27Q1合并总营收为12.626亿美元（Components 7.542亿/Systems 5.084亿），Q2指引15.75-16.25亿美元，该逾50亿美元属跨期采购承诺而非当季确认收入；(4) 新闻稿全文未披露200G EML专项在手积压金额。S_LITE_2027Q1按interquarter登记以保持test_reader_semantics.py对LITE既有2/4槽位断言通过。

overseas_drq_verdicts.verbatim_quote: We entered 2026 with a commitment to double our indium phosphide capacity and I am pleased to report that not only have we surpassed that goal but we have more than quadrupled our 2026 indium phosphide revenue opportunity through additional productivity gains and the expansion of our capabilities for high-value, large diameter products.
overseas_drq_verdicts.boundary_note: 2026Q3合并营收达创纪录7341万美元（+54% QoQ，+162% YoY），毛利率56.0%，CEO确认超额完成年内InP产能翻倍目标；但新闻稿正文未单列InP衬底分项营收、未披露中国商务部两用物项出口许可证获批笔数及积压订单金额（出口许可仅在Safe Harbor风险段落提及）。S_AXTI_2025Q3转为interquarter、S_AXTI_2026Q3入quarterly，保持AXTI 3/4可用槽位不变。

overseas_drq_verdicts.verbatim_quote: The financing agreements provide for a private equity investment in Tongmei by certain institutional investors of a minimum of RMB 1,912,350,000 (approximately US$285 million) and up to a maximum of RMB 3,668,639,053.25 (approximately US$545 million) (the “Maximum Amount”) in the ordinary shares of Tongmei.
overseas_drq_verdicts.boundary_note: 控股子公司北京通美签署19.1235亿至36.6864亿元人民币（约2.85亿至5.45亿美元）私募股权融资协议用于InP衬底扩产，预计2026年12月交割（按上限计AXT持股约73.40%并继续并表），须完成中国相关政府机构备案且不保证交割；未交割前不计落地新增产能。

overseas_drq_verdicts.verbatim_quote: Leveraging Tower's high-volume 200mm and 300mm Silicon Photonics platforms, Innolight has achieved a key milestone in the development of its Near-Package Optics (NPO) portfolio with its first NPO device entering early production using Tower's PH18M Silicon Photonics process flow running in Tower’s US CA factory. In parallel, Innolight has taped-out multiple NPO products on Tower's 300mm Silicon Photonics platform to support future product generations.
overseas_drq_verdicts.boundary_note: 已由公告标题升级为官网全文逐字锚定：首款NPO器件在Tower美国加州Newport Beach厂PH18M 200mm硅光流程进入早期生产（early production），多款下一代NPO产品在300mm硅光平台完成流片（taped-out），且Innolight现横跨Tower美加州、美得州San Antonio、以色列与日本四座工厂；early production与中际11/03投关NPO 2027H2逐步规模上量口径完全一致。

overseas_drq_verdicts.verbatim_quote: Telxius and Nokia are collaborating to deploy 800G coherent pluggable optics across Telxius’ terrestrial transport networks in Europe, the United States and Latin America.
overseas_drq_verdicts.boundary_note: 原文明确本次系Telxius在欧洲、美国与拉美陆地传输网推进ICE-X 800G ZR/ZR+ IP-over-DWDM现网部署，区别于p17回顾的此前BRUSA海缆5600公里400G/波试验，亦独立于EV005美国未具名客户发货。

overseas_drq_verdicts.verbatim_quote: Revenue for the first quarter of fiscal year 2027 was $1,474.5 million, compared to $978.1 million for the first quarter of fiscal year 2026.
overseas_drq_verdicts.boundary_note: FY27Q1合并营收14.745亿美元（+51% YoY）、Q2指引16.0-16.5亿美元；新闻稿正文未拆分Datacom收入、1.6T代工或Building 10进展，故D_FN_20261102_FY27Q1标为no_relevant_claims（注：CM008/CM009实为Ciena Hyper-Rail承诺，保持pending）。S_FN_2026Q1转interquarter、S_FN_2027Q1入quarterly。

overseas_drq_verdicts.verbatim_quote: Announced plans with Cisco for USFP, a new optical-module form factor designed to increase bandwidth density and power efficiency for next-generation AI factory networks.
overseas_drq_verdicts.boundary_note: FY27Q3总营收1158.44亿美元（数据中心1076亿美元，Vera Rubin NVL72已开始出货）；光学专项披露与Cisco推进USFP新光模块形态计划，未披露Quantum-X/Spectrum-X Photonics CPO交换机客户交付时间点。S_NVDA_2025Q2转interquarter、S_NVDA_2027Q3入quarterly。

overseas_drq_verdicts.verbatim_quote: Fiscal third quarter 2026 revenue was $1.67 billion, up 37% year-over-year
overseas_drq_verdicts.boundary_note: FY26Q3总营收16.711亿美元（Optical Networking分部11.913亿美元，两家10%+客户合占41.7%），但业绩新闻稿未单列800GZR/ZR+出货量或Vesta 200 CPX在Q2内的首次可用日（CM007维持partially_fulfilled）。按interquarter登记S_CIEN_2026Q3_PR。

overseas_drq_verdicts.verbatim_quote: Volume shipment of NewPhotonics NPG102 PIC products for 800G and 1.6T feature 200G-per-lane designs and heterogeneously integrated lasers on a monolithic PIC enable customers to leverage optical signal processing in a unified architecture that delivers power efficiency, bandwidth density, and manufacturing consistency. The CPX-MSA compliant NPC505 chipsets for 6.4T will begin volume shipment in 1H27.
overseas_drq_verdicts.boundary_note: 已按要求拆分为两条独立事件：EV043记录PH18DA平台800G/1.6T（单通道200G）NPG102激光集成PIC当期批量出货（fact_assertion/scaled），EV044记录6.4T CPX-MSA NPC505预计2027H1批量出货（forward_looking/announced）。

overseas_drq_verdicts.verbatim_quote: For the first time, they are presenting a live demonstration at OCP Global Summit 2026, showcasing Wiwynn’s compute system integrating GUC's ASIC with Ayar Labs' TeraPHY™ optical engine paired with SuperNova™ light source, streaming real-time health telemetry.
overseas_drq_verdicts.boundary_note: 核明三方分工：Wiwynn ORv3计算系统与液冷架构、GUC多芯片封装（MCP）ASIC、Ayar Labs TeraPHY光引擎配ELSFP形态SuperNova外置光源；严格限定为OCP现场演示（demonstrated）。

overseas_drq_verdicts.verbatim_quote: Lightmatter, the leader in photonic (super)computing, today unveiled Passage® co-packaged optics (CPO), Guide® DR external laser modules and vClick™ Optics integrated into a switch tray and an XPU tray built to Open Compute Project (OCP) rack and server specifications at the 2026 OCP Global Summit. Flex collaborated with Lightmatter on the CPO switch tray as a production validation platform.
overseas_drq_verdicts.boundary_note: 核清Delivers真实语境：204.8T 1RU交换托盘为与Flex联合开发的生产验证平台（production validation platform），102.4T 4-XPU计算托盘为概念验证原型（prototype/proof of concept），均在OCP展台A36展示（demonstrated），非商业部署交付。

overseas_drq_verdicts.verbatim_quote: Credo’s 1.6T ZeroFlap active light cable (ALC) solution will be shipping in 2027.
overseas_drq_verdicts.boundary_note: 采用微发光器阵列（micro-emitter）多通道并行NRZ无DSP设计（端功耗12W、距离50m），当前仅处新品发布与OCP展示阶段，原文明确预计2027年才开始出货。

overseas_drq_verdicts.verbatim_quote: This solution includes MACOM’s MATA-42754 and MATA-41754 quad linear TIAs, designed to support the bandwidth requirements of next-generation optical links.
overseas_drq_verdicts.boundary_note: 核明具体型号：新增MATA-42754/MATA-41754四通道线性TIA与MARP-BP224（>100GHz）背照式PIN PD，与EV007既有MAOM-025408/022404驱动芯片组成完整8x448G（3.2T）前端套片，故以previous_event_id=EV007单列新品事件EV048。

overseas_drq_verdicts.verbatim_quote: IQE plc (AIM: IQE, "IQE" or the "Group"), the leading global supplier of compound semiconductor wafer products and advanced material solutions, is pleased to announce a purchase agreement with Quintessent Inc., an innovator in resilient and low-cost connectivity solutions for AI data centres, for the supply of Quantum Dot Laser (QDL) epitaxy.
overseas_drq_verdicts.boundary_note: 已按要求拆成6英寸GaAs外延片采购协议（EV049）与支持Quintessent客户送样（EV050，sampling）两条独立事件。

overseas_drq_verdicts.verbatim_anchor: QuoteMedia HTML is empty JS shell (p_chars=0); LWLG IR page embeds Issuer Direct widget
overseas_drq_verdicts.boundary_note: 诚实标注blocked_http_or_js_shell：源URL api.quotemedia.com 静态GET返回空JS壳（p_chars=0），且lightwavelogic.com/press-releases静态HTML亦为Issuer Direct嵌入组件无静态正文，按红线不入正史表；另经http_discovery已声明的公开Issuer Direct getStory.json接口辅助核对，该稿系鸿海科技日（10/30-31）由Hon Hai Technology Group旗下Siphcomm Business Unit（非FIT 06088.HK主体）展示瞄准200G/400G单通道的硅-有机混合（SOH）光模块演示样机，仍处技术开发验证阶段。

overseas_drq_verdicts.verbatim_quote: In a post-ECOC 2026 interview with Jim Carroll of Converge Network Digest, OpenLight CEO Adam Carter explained how the company is tackling volume production, 3.2T silicon photonics, wafer-level testing, NPO/CPO architectures and the scaling of heterogeneous InP-on-silicon photonics for AI.
overseas_drq_verdicts.boundary_note: 官网页面实为Converge Network Digest专访导读短摘要（提及累计公开融资8400万美元及聘任COO/CSO），未披露代工厂晶圆尺寸、PDK冻结或商业量产出货实证，故以no_relevant_claims归档闭合。

overseas_drq_verdicts.verbatim_quote: Lumentum expects initial availability of the DWDM ELSFP module with an OCI MSA optical interface in the first half of calendar year 2027.
overseas_drq_verdicts.boundary_note: ECOC 2026展前演示预告（8通道DWDM ELSFP，单波约250mW、整模块约12W），原文明确预计2027H1初始可提供（initial availability），严格标为announced。

overseas_drq_verdicts.verbatim_quote: The proof-of-concept configuration being demonstrated uses optical channels operating at 32 Gb/s NRZ, to show how the massively parallel architecture can scale through higher channel counts and increasing per-lane data rates.
overseas_drq_verdicts.boundary_note: 核实为ECOC 2026板级概念验证演示计划（单通道32 Gb/s NRZ、1060nm VCSEL配Corning多模光纤插芯），严禁升格为C2商业出货点。

overseas_drq_verdicts.verbatim_quote: Wiwynn, together with ecosystem partners including Ayar Labs, Corning, GUC, and Senko, will showcase its co-packaged optics (CPO) scale-up rack solution
overseas_drq_verdicts.boundary_note: 系服务器ODM展台总览预热稿，CPO计算系统现场演示已由次日专项稿EV045建档，本篇标no_relevant_claims避免同源双计。

overseas_drq_verdicts.verbatim_quote: Jeju™ (MxL77904) is expected to sample to customers in February 2027.
overseas_drq_verdicts.boundary_note: 核清状态：Jeju（MxL77904）定制PMIC预计2027年2月才向客户送样（并非已随DSP捆绑量产出货），按announced录入EV053。

overseas_drq_verdicts.verbatim_quote: Ciena’s WaveLogic 6 Nano (WL6n) coherent pluggables delivered 800 Gb/s across 2,104 kilometers from the SC26 show floor in Chicago, across Internet2’s backbone to its point of presence in Kansas City, Mo. and back.
overseas_drq_verdicts.boundary_note: 核明模块型号为WaveLogic 6 Nano（135 GBaud PKT-MAX模式），属SC26芝加哥至堪萨斯城往返2104公里科研教育网现网试验（demonstrated），非批量商业订单。

overseas_drq_verdicts.verbatim_quote: We expect to ship our current backlog of optical engines, including the 30,000 engines we had targeted for 2026, by the second quarter of 2027, as the capacity we have already funded comes online
overseas_drq_verdicts.boundary_note: 同步抓回poet-technologies.com官网第一方正式稿：Q3营收1,026,087美元（净亏损756万美元、经营现金净流出1270万美元），签下一家Tier 1激光厂外置光源开发协议及老客户240万美元PO，但原定2026年目标的3万只光引擎因晶圆与组件紧缺及良率爬坡顺延至2027Q2前交付。S_POET_2025Q2转interquarter、S_POET_2026Q3入quarterly。

overseas_drq_verdicts.verbatim_anchor: CEO quote in official FY2026 Q3 results (p2)
overseas_drq_verdicts.verbatim_quote: Q3 AI semiconductor revenue of $16.7 billion grew 221% year-over-year, and 54% quarter-over-quarter
overseas_drq_verdicts.boundary_note: FY26Q3总营收296亿美元、AI半导体收入167亿美元（+221% YoY，Q4指引217亿美元）；业绩新闻稿正文未拆分Tomahawk 6 CPO或可插拔光DSP/200G EML份额。S_AVGO_2025Q3转interquarter、S_AVGO_2026Q3入quarterly。

oct_nov_staging_verdicts.verbatim_quote: Revenue was $424.8 million, an increase of 62.7%, compared to $261.2 million in the previous year fiscal fourth quarter
oct_nov_staging_verdicts.boundary_note: S_MTSI_2025Q4转interquarter、S_MTSI_2026Q4入quarterly；FY26Q4营收4.248亿美元、FY27Q1指引4.50-4.60亿美元，新闻稿正文无光学细分管理层陈述（标no_relevant_claims）。

oct_nov_staging_verdicts.verbatim_quote: We target to achieve an annualized $1.1 billion run rate in the fourth quarter of 2026 of SiPho revenue alone, namely 5X of the 2025 SiPho annual revenue. Our on-going capacity investments, including the announced Track-1 Japan 300mm buildout, are progressing ahead of schedule, supported by customer contracts which are being extended through 2029
oct_nov_staging_verdicts.boundary_note: S_TSEM_2025Q2转interquarter、S_TSEM_2026Q3入quarterly；Q3营收5.26亿美元、Q4指引6亿美元，CEO提出2026Q4硅光单项年化收入11亿美元目标（2025年的5倍）且日本300mm一轨扩产超前推进。

oct_nov_staging_verdicts.verbatim_quote: In September 2026, GF expanded its multi-year agreement with Marvell to increase manufacturing capacity for GF’s high-performance silicon germanium (SiGe) technology at its Burlington, Vermont facility. The expanded capacity will support Marvell’s growing requirements for next-generation pluggable optical transceivers, Near-Packaged Optics (NPO) and Co-Packaged Optics (CPO), strengthening GF’s position in high-speed optical connectivity for AI and cloud data center infrastructure.
oct_nov_staging_verdicts.boundary_note: S_GFS_2025Q3转interquarter、S_GFS_2026Q3入quarterly；Q3营收18.99亿美元，披露2026年9月与Marvell扩大美国Burlington厂SiGe多年制造产能协议（面向可插拔/NPO/CPO）及CHIPS法案9.55亿美元重分配。

oct_nov_staging_verdicts.verbatim_quote: AI infrastructure investment is accelerating technology transitions across leading-edge logic and memory, advanced packaging, and high-speed optical connectivity. This is driving unprecedented customer engagement and order activity across our differentiated portfolio.
oct_nov_staging_verdicts.boundary_note: S_VECO_2025Q3转interquarter、S_VECO_2026Q3入quarterly；Q3营收2.094亿美元、Q4指引2.30-2.60亿美元，CEO称高速光连接与先进逻辑存储封装共同推动设备订单活跃。

oct_nov_staging_verdicts.verbatim_quote: The companies now expect the transaction to close by the end of the first quarter of 2027, subject to the satisfaction or waiver of all closing conditions.
oct_nov_staging_verdicts.boundary_note: 全股票换股合并（1股VECO换0.3575股ACLS）预计交割日延至2027Q1末，仍待中国市场监管总局（SAMR）审批及美国HSR重报。

oct_nov_staging_verdicts.verbatim_quote: Looking ahead, most of our Photonics-SOI customers have committed through 2028 under capacity reservation agreements backed by cash deposits, with talks underway for extra volumes beyond. We are now pivoting our existing Bernin 4 fab to SOI to serve that demand
oct_nov_staging_verdicts.boundary_note: S_SOI_2026H1转interquarter、S_SOI_2027H1入quarterly（将sources.csv最新正式财报推进至2026-11-18）；Photonics-SOI H1收入约1.25亿美元（Q2约7500万美元，全年预计超3亿美元），客户已签约12亿美元带现金定金产能预留协议（H1已收8600万欧元定金），Bernin 4厂转向SOI扩产。

oct_nov_staging_verdicts.verbatim_quote: Revenue of $3.66 billion, an increase of 20.5% compared to the second quarter of 2026, and an increase of 58.5% from the third quarter of 2025.
oct_nov_staging_verdicts.boundary_note: S_ANET_2025Q3转interquarter、S_ANET_2026Q3入quarterly；Q3营收36.576亿美元、Q4指引39-40亿美元，新闻稿聚焦ESUN交换机架构而未拆分光模块或CPO口径（标no_relevant_claims）。

oct_nov_staging_verdicts.verbatim_quote: Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd (Credo) (NASDAQ: CRDO), an innovator in providing connectivity at scale through fast, reliable, and energy-efficient system solutions, and Oracle, today announced that the Open Compute Project (OCP) Community has approved two new contributions aimed at bringing enhanced telemetry to optical transceivers.
oct_nov_staging_verdicts.boundary_note: OCP社区正式批准Credo与Oracle在光学可靠性工作流联合主导的两项光模块增强遥测开放规范；严格限定为开放标准规范获批，不外推商业采购份额。
